parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem: A digital signal is produced by sampling an analogue signal and passing the samples through an analogue-to-digital converter (ADC).
parts.text: State what is meant by a digital signal.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State one change to the sampling or to the ADC that will improve the accuracy of reproduction of the original analogue signal.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: The least significant bit of the four-bit digital number 1100 represents a signal voltage of $2.5\text{ mV}$. Determine the signal voltage, in $\text{mV}$, represented by this digital number.
